meta.rule: Description contains flat or self-contained, and conversion / convert / subdiv / sub-div. House wording is a heuristic, not a verified classification.

rows.description: Application for a lawful development certificate (proposed) to convert the conversion of ground floor and first floor flats into a single dwelling house and the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate a rear dormer extension including two roof lights to the front and construction of an outbuilding as a gym and store with a bathroom.

Conversion of existing 2 bedroom dwelling house into 2No. Flats (1x two bedroom and 1x one bedroom) including demolition of garage and construction of two storey side and single storey rear extension.

Conversion of commercial unit with 1no 2-bed flat above into 5 self-contained flats comprising of 2x 2-bed, 2x 1-bed & 1x studio, involving the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate an L-shaped rear dormer extension including three roof lights to the front and a balcony to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation, a part two storey part single storey rear extension including a first floor rear balcony and alterations to the front elevation.

Conversion of existing dwelling into two 3x bedroom flats with the construction of a rear dormer extension including two roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation.

Construction of first floor side extension and loft conversion including a rear dormer window in conjunction with the conversion of the property into 3 residential units c omprising ( 1x 1 bedroom and 2x 2 Bedroom flats) with associate cycle, refuse storages, private amenity and parking

Conversion of commercial unit with 1no 2-bed flat above into a commercial unit with 4 self-contained flats comprising of 2x 2-bed and 2x 1-bed, involving the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate an L-shaped rear dormer extension including three roof lights to the front and a balcony to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation and a part two storey part single storey rear extension including a first floor rear balcony.

Conversion of existing hmo dwelling into three flats (1x two bedroom, 2x one bedroom) including construction of a first floor side extension, part two storey-part single storey rear extension and alterations to the roof.

Conversion of existing dwelling into two (3x bedroom flats) with the construction of a rear dormer extension including two roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation.
Conversion of existing dwellinghouse into 2 flats (2x 1 bedroom), including the construction of a part two storey part single storey rear extension and a new first floor side window.

Change of use of part of the ground floor from an office to a C3 2x bedroom flat including the addition of windows to the side elevation, construction of a first floor rear extension and the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate a rear dormer extension including three roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into a new 1x bedroom flat.

Refurbishment of the ground floor shop including the construction of a single storey rear extension, new entrance to the upper floor flat and direct corridor access to the bike and refuse area; construction of rear extensions to both the first and second floors of the upstairs flat; construction of a rear dormer extension including two roof lights to the front and a Juliette balcony to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation; and the division of the upstairs flat into a 1 bedroom flat and a 2 bedroom flat.

Conversion of existing dwelling into 3 flats (1x studio, 1x 2 bedroom and 1x 3 bedroom) including internal alterations, a rear dormer extension including one roof light to the rear, four roof lights to the front and six windows to the side, with associated cycle parking and refuse storage.
Application for a lawful development certificate (existing) for the conversion of the property into three 2 bedroom flats and a single storey side extension.

Construction of a Rear Dormer extension including four roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation, a rear partial two storey extension and a side two storey extension to provide 2 new residential units (one 3 bedroom flat and two 2 bedroom flats).

Conversion of single dwelling semi-detached house into 2no self-contained flats comprising 1 x 3-bed & 1 x 2-bed and the construction of a single storey front and side extension following the demolition of the existing side extension.
Conversion of existing dwellinghouse into 2 flats (2x 1 bedroom), including the construction of a part two storey part single storey rear extension with associated amenity space and cycle spaces

Conversion of the existing dwelling house into two self-contained flats (1x one bed and 1x two bed), including the construction of a part two storey part single storey side and rear extension and a new front porch.

Conversion of the existing 2-bedroom dwelling into two 1x bedroom flats involving the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension (attached to 21/02090/CLUP), a single storey rear extension (attached to 21/02089/PRIEXT) and a two storey side extension (attached to 21/02088/HSE)

Conversion of the existing dwelling house into two self-contained flats (1x one bed and 1x three bed), including the construction of a part two storey part single storey side and rear extension and a new front porch.

Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning consent 20/01302/FULL dated 16/08/2020 to allow for a hip-to-gable loft conversion to accommodate a rear dormer extension to allow for 1 additional bedroom for flat 2. Conversion of dwellinghouse into 2 self-contained flats (1 x 3-bed & 1 x 1-bed) involving the construction of a front porch, demolition of existing side extension, construction of a new single storey side extension and the construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate a rear dormer

Change of use of part of ground floor from Use Class E to C3 to form a 1x bedroom flat with associated car parking, cycle and refuse storage, construction of a two storey rear extension and construction of a rear dormer extension to facilitate conversion of roof space into 1x studio flat

Conversion of dwellinghouse into 3 flats and demolition of existing conservatory and construction of a part two storey part single storey rear extension and construction of a hip-to-gable roof extension to accommodate a rear dormer extension including one roof light to the front.

Application for a lawful development certificate (proposed) for the construction of loft conversion, replace existing roof and change of use from storage B1 to C3 Residential Use to create 5 additional flats.
